name: Project Sync / Status Update
description: Weekly or bi-weekly project status meeting focusing on milestones and risks.
description_it: Riunione periodica di stato del progetto su milestone e rischi.

sections.title: Meeting Date & Time
sections.instruction: Date, time and facilitator only if stated in the transcript, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Attendees
sections.instruction: Names and roles of the people present as they appear in the transcript; generic labels such as 'Speaker A' are not names

sections.title: Milestones & Status
sections.instruction: Milestones discussed with status; ETA only if stated, otherwise 'Not stated'

sections.title: Progress Summary
sections.instruction: Short paragraph summarizing progress since last sync meeting

sections.title: Top Risks & Mitigations
sections.instruction: List top risks with impact level, mitigation plan, and owner

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: Decisions explicitly agreed, with the rationale given and the [mm:ss] timestamp of the transcript line

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Tasks with owner, due date, priority and status; any field not stated in the call is 'Not stated'

sections.title: Related Documents
sections.instruction: Documents, tickets or designs mentioned by name; URLs only if spelled out in the call
